featured_reviews.review_text:
Modern Juice Center is an absolute gem if you’re craving flavor-packed shawarmas and juicy, satisfying burgers! 🌯🍔
Their shawarma is perfectly spiced, loaded with tender meat, and wrapped just right — every bite hits with bold, Middle Eastern-inspired flavors. The burgers? Super juicy, cheesy, and loaded with all the good stuff.

Pair it with one of their fresh juices or thick shakes, and you’ve got yourself a complete, lip-smacking meal.

Great taste, quick service, and pocket-friendly prices — what more can you ask for? A must-try spot for street-style cravings done right! 🔥

featured_reviews.name: Mufaddal Patanwala
featured_reviews.review_text:
Tucked in the bustling lanes of Colaba, Modern Juice Centre has quietly become one of my most reliable late-night go-to spots. Whenever post-10 pm cravings kick in, this place is almost always on my mind—mainly because it stays open late and never disappoints.

My absolute top picks here are the mulberry juice and tender coconut drink. The mulberry juice has a rich, slightly tangy sweetness that feels both refreshing and indulgent at the same time, while the tender coconut is as clean and hydrating as it gets—perfect balance after a long day.

When it comes to food, their sandwiches and shorma are my default add-ons. The sandwiches are crisp, well-filled, and consistently satisfying, while the shorma is simple but hits the spot, especially late at night when you want something filling yet not too heavy.

What makes this place special is its reliability—you know exactly what you’ll get every single time. No fancy setup, no frills—just good food, quick service, and the comfort of knowing it’s there when most places have shut down. For late-night hunger in South Mumbai, this spot is hard to beat.

featured_reviews.name: Aziz _004
featured_reviews.review_text:
Modern Juice Center serves bold, flavorful shawarmas, juicy loaded burgers, and refreshing fresh juices/shakes all at great prices.

With quick service and consistently tasty street-style food, it’s a must-visit spot for satisfying cravings.

One of my favorites is the chicken shawarma tender, well-spiced, and delicious along with their cold coffee shake, which is rich, refreshing, and the perfect match.

featured_reviews.name: Rahul Yadav
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently visited Amar Juice Centre, a place I’d heard quite a bit about—especially for its pav bhaji.

I tried the butter pav bhaji and a mango shake. To be honest, the pav bhaji didn’t quite live up to the hype for me. It was decent, but nothing particularly memorable, and it didn’t really satisfy that nostalgic craving for authentic Mumbai-style pav bhaji that I was hoping for.

The mango shake, however, was the standout. It was fresh, flavorful, and easily the highlight of the visit.

The setup is pretty straightforward—located right on the main road, with a stand-and-eat format. You can also enjoy your food in your parked car, which is quite convenient. The staff was courteous, and the service was impressively quick, which adds to the overall ease of the experience.

Overall, Amar Juice Centre is worth a stop for its juices and quick bites, but if you're going in with high expectations for the pav bhaji, you might find it a bit underwhelming.

Figtree is a small cafe that is tucked away in a corner in adarsh nagar. Although the place isn't quite large but I was glad to see the level of hygiene that they had maintained.

We went here to pick up our parcel and that's when we were so happy to see how clean and tidy this place was. Not only that, they also serve excellent food. They have a vast menu in fresh creams. Right from fruits to also dry fruits and they also serve drinks that are delicious and healthy. So we tried the dry fruit cream which was rich and super delicious. We even tried their paneer makhani pizza and bhaji sandwich. I must say, I was really impressed with their hospitality.

This place is surely a must try! Especially for their fresh creams. And they are operating till morning 5!

featured_reviews.name: Aditya Dubey
featured_reviews.review_text:
One of the best delivery kitchen that is open till 5 a.m.
1. Their Paneer Makhani Pizza is so amazing and everyone must try it. Soft, cheesy and mouth watering pizza, it's a 10/10 pizza.
The fresh creams are super delicious and my family is most favourite is
2. Sitafal cream - We were 3 people but ordered 4 of them, it was super yummy and delicious and we kept on eating it and finished all so soon.
We also tried the
3. Anjeer cream - it was loaded with lot of Anjeer and lot of dry fruits, cream which was creamy and delicious and the sweetness was just right.
We also tried the  4. Cheese club sandwich - it was loaded with lot of vegetables that was freshly chopped and it was loaded with lot of cheese, it was very filling and yummy.
The service is very good and the staff is very humble and helpful. The place is neat and clean. We had a lovely experience with good quality food.

featured_reviews.name: Styletravelzest !!!
featured_reviews.review_text:
I am a big fan of sitafal cream and me and my family has to drive all the way to HajiAli every weekend to enjoy the sitafal cream or seasonal creams and shakes from there.

However I recently discovered a small and a cute Cafe near my house called - The fig tree which is located in Adarsh Nagar in Oshiwara. it is a delivery kitchen and it is open from 5 p.m. to 5 a.m. which is also the best part as if you have a late night sweet craving then this is the best place to order from. They are available on Zomato and swiggy both and they always deliver fresh food.

We picked up our parcel and we enjoyed our most favourite
1) Sitafal cream - it is highly recommended that you try the sitafal cream from the fig tree because it was amazing. it is a must try here. this was very very very fresh and delicious.

2) Kulfi falooda - the added a lot of  Kulfi ice cream and milk and blended the same, the glass had falooda, subja, this thick Kulfi shake and it was again topped with kulfi ice cream scoop and lot of dry fruits and jelly, loved it.

3) Pomegranate juice - fresh juice removed in front of me and I reached a little early and why must say the juice was tasty and the hygiene that they maintained was amazing.

The staff was very humble and helpful. This place is very hygienic I must say. Their Pizzas and sandwiches are also amazing.

featured_reviews.name: shazaan khan
featured_reviews.review_text:
The delivery was perfectly within the time, the food was prepared quickly and it was still hot when delivered. To be honest, the first impression of the food was amazing
Really tasty and super secured, super hygienic delivery.
We ordered

1)The fig tree special dry fruit cream:-it was sooo good and So perfectly made!!
2)Veg cheese grilled sandwich :-Hitting the perfect tones with every bite
3)Veg schezwan pizza :-Highly recommended
Service - 5/5 Food - 5/5 Price - 5/5 Overall Rating - 5/5

featured_reviews.name: Shweta Bulani
featured_reviews.review_text: Searching for a snack one evening came across this place and ordered a few things. Firstly the cheese grilled sandwich, came hot and crispy with loaded cheese inside and outside. Secondly the mozzarella pizza, packed very well with chopped veggies in pizza sauce and topped with sliced tomatoes and mozzarella cheese. As a drink got the watermelon juice came fresh with Chunks of watermelon. Really impressed with the packaging of this place. The sandwich and a juice by themselves could keep you full for hours.

featured_reviews.name: Akshata Manjrekar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Recently we tried out fig tree which is famous for it's Cream and faloodas.
I tried special falooda and I am totally impressed by the taste,it was superb yummy.
Then I had dragon fruit cream which is something new for me and it was really good.
Properly packaged with great consistency and totally refreshing.
At last I had veg Schezwan pizza which was overloaded with cheese and lots of topings on it, I enjoyed it a lot.
Do try out.

featured_reviews.name: Jash Notaria
featured_reviews.review_text:
Saw this place on the app and decided to order from there. We called for

A. Dryfruit Falooda - Rich in taste, Good one. Should try definetly.

B. Dryfruit Cream - Had lot of Dryfruits and the cream is super

Overall packed well and delivered on time and not at all tampered.

featured_reviews.review_text:
🔰 The Fig tree is one of the best fresh cloud kitchens serving some fresh healthy juices and Snacks.

🔰 The Fig Tree serves varieties of fresh juices, healthy snacks and delicious cream with tasty falooda.

🔰I ordered Orange Juice which was very fresh and Morzeralla Pizza which was very delicious and a bit average packaging and delivered on time.

featured_reviews.name: Shabbir Chandabhai
featured_reviews.review_text:
In my teenage years, I remember frequenting this location in Mumbai close to Gateway of India for a nice tall Varanasi glass of sugarcane juice…

After many years, I visited again today to quench my thirst for some sugarcane juice.

Everything is still the same, but I’m glad that they now have small portions available because there was no way I could finish the super tall  Varanasi glass!!

We met the owner who was super friendly like always …

Thank you once again for the tasty sugar, green juice and great conversations…

featured_reviews.name: Chaitanyaa Mehta
featured_reviews.review_text: If you’re not a fan of sugar cane juice then do not visit the place. It’s run by two brothers who will serve you a fresh sugar cane juice like no other in the city. It’s a must visit for the small conversation and a a fantastic juice. My family has been visiting this place since decades and it’s never disappointed.

featured_reviews.name: Aatmi
featured_reviews.review_text:

They also sell ice creams, cold drinks, and packaged food items.

Beside it, there’s also a small shop selling idols of gods and goddesses in different sizes along with other items people often buy as souvenirs.

featured_reviews.name: Nidhi Shetty
featured_reviews.review_text: Refreshing sugarcane juice like many other places. But the cleanliness part definitely makes them special!

featured_reviews.name: Dr Shivani Vakilwala
featured_reviews.review_text: This is The Best sugarcane juice serving place in town, my father used to take me here since my childhood, the juice is so fresh and it comes in three sizes, we always have the biggest one 😋 the owner who sits opposite is extremely kind and softspoken and he only told us that theres a 5 percent discount for students and there is also a board kept where its mentioned that he gives discount to army personnel,a  place is truely famous when you do not need publicity 😊

featured_reviews.name: ngawang sherpa
featured_reviews.review_text: The best sugarcane juice I have ever had. The price is great for the quality you get. They only put the sugarcane once through the machine. They also use filtered water for their ice, so if you want to cool your drink, their ice is good. I don't like to add ice in mine, but you can. Whenever I am in mumbai, I make sure to go there at least once, and if I am in South mumbai, then I go every day.

featured_reviews.name: Kazhian Muthusami (Kaz)
featured_reviews.review_text: When you are at Gateway of India dont miss having sugarcane juice here. They crush only when you place the order and its a hygiene environment . Price is nominal

featured_reviews.name: Harsh Shah

Highly recommend this place.

featured_reviews.review_text: Think Juice in Colaba is one of those places that instantly makes a hot Mumbai day better. The first sip of a cold, thick shake truly feels like happiness in a glass. featured_reviews.review_text:
CAUTION ! BAGDADI'S JUICE CENTRE uses Stale Strawberries with Fungus for milkshakes ! This is horrible!  They do not even wash the Strawberries before blending!  The person who was preparing the milkshake had the audacity to say that they haven't been instructed to clean the fruits before preparing the milkshake. This will definitely cause dangerous infections to the person consuming the milk shakes or juice at this place.
This is very sad to see such places who are soo negligent about serving such unedible food soo proudly at soo prime locations like Gateway of India and Colaba proximity. The foreigners who consume these food end up being sick and then the blame goes to the entire food and hospitality fraternity!
Please go to Bagdadi at their own risk !

featured_reviews.name: Swapnil Chaudhari (swap)
featured_reviews.review_text:
Shree Snacks & Juice Centre, located near the Chandramukhi Building on BRP Marg in Nariman Point, Mumbai, is a popular vegetarian eatery known for its affordable and tasty offerings.  With an average cost of ₹200 for two people, it caters to office-goers and locals seeking quick bites.

The menu features a variety of fast food items and fresh juices.  Patrons have praised items like the brown bread masala toast sandwich, samosa toast sandwich, and paneer pizza for their flavor and value.   Seasonal specials, such as the raw mango panini during mango season, are also highlighted by customers.

While the food quality is generally appreciated, some feedback points to areas for improvement.  For instance, a reviewer noted that the watermelon juice was overly sweetened with added sugar.   Additionally, service experiences vary; one patron commended the quality of service, while another found it lacking.

The establishment offers indoor seating and operates from 8 AM to 9 PM, making it a convenient spot for breakfast, lunch, or an evening snack.   Overall, Shree Snacks & Juice Centre provides a budget-friendly dining option in the heart of Mumbai's business district.

featured_reviews.name: Noel Nadar
featured_reviews.review_text: This Apsara Ice Cream outlet is located in Colaba. Apsara Ice Cream is one of my favourite ice cream brands and it has become quite popular in the last decade. Although it's a small outlet, the ice creams here are really good! Most of the time I've had choco chips ice cream here, being my favourite flavours. Mississippi Chocolate, Cookies n Cream & Choco Brownie are also some of the good flavours that I've tried.

featured_reviews.name: Ketan Rindani
featured_reviews.review_text: Excellent taste. But but but...ice creams in Mumbai are too expensive compared to Gujarat. Most people don't need ambience. They need good ice cream at a price that would make them come back for more, more and more.

featured_reviews.name: Jatin Shah
featured_reviews.review_text:
I love visiting Apsara Ice Cream, everytime, whenever I get a chance to do so. This time around was at their Colaba outlet. Was in the vicinity with family when we checked in post dinner. Nice cozy outlet, with decent space for seating.

Well i will be honest, my craving for favorite Pan Pasand actually pulled me towards the outlet, but the best part was that since we were 4 members, I got to try these some of their other amazing flavours as well.

The ones that I tried besides Pan Pasand, were Guava Glory - one of the highest selling ice-creams for Apsara. Just love the chilli masala that they put on top of it. I am personally a big fan of Falooda as well and tried for the first time in ice-cream form - Falooda Funda. The best part is you even find sabja seeds and vermicelli (sev) also in the ice-cream. A great job.

Interestingly, they have introduced a new flavour which again i was curious to try out. And that was the Spice N Nuts. A nice mix of crushed nuts along with spices, tasted really good. Recommended especially those who like the Roasted Almonds here. Shall be a good change for sure.

Till next time, hopefully soon!

featured_reviews.name: Chilkesh Kumar
featured_reviews.review_text: Always have a very good experience with apsara. I been to 2-3 outlet and my kids they do like these icecream 🍨.

featured_reviews.name: SOHINI GUPTA
featured_reviews.review_text: Varities of icecream in good taste, kids enjoyed, i tried Guava flavour which was recommended by my friend Manasi, it was really good. Other 2 flavour was paan pasand and kesar pista. We enjoyed.

featured_reviews.name: vrun gupta
featured_reviews.review_text: Nice variety of ice-cream available,  specially for who are looking for sugar free ice-cream and on every 22nd you will get 50% off on any ice-cream

featured_reviews.name: Arjit Raj
featured_reviews.review_text: Great taste. Rasamalai, Belgian chocolate, Jackfruit, Gulkand were tried. Highly recommended. Great taste and value for money. Cons: small place with less seating area. Neat and clean place.

featured_reviews.name: Dharnik Shah
featured_reviews.review_text: Some very different flavours of GOOD ice cream. It's a small outlet so get full if there are 4-5 customers inside. Must try the Guava and Chilli.
